chunks: Strive in the way of God with a striving that is His due.
He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty.
The faith of your father Abraham.
He named you Muslims before, and in this (Quran).
So that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and you may be witnesses over mankind.
So establish prayer and give zakat and hold firmly to God.
He is your protector; excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

key_terms.حَقَ جِهَادِهِ: A striving worthy of God's status/full effort

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'strive in the way of God with a striving that is His due' according to Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the concept of *Jihad* as comprehensive striving, often linked to the Imamate as the true inheritors of Abraham's monotheistic legacy. The phrase 'He named you Muslims beforehand' is interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as divine foreknowledge of the community's identity, reinforcing the continuity of the prophetic mission. The concluding commands to establish prayer and pay zakat are viewed not merely as rituals but as acts of political and spiritual allegiance to the Imam, who serves as the ultimate *Mawla* (protector and guide).
